jobs.title: Software Technical Writer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We're looking for a Senior or Staff Technical Writer to join the Sonar documentation team. We want someone who thinks like a developer, writes like a communicator, and builds documentation the same way engineers build software.

You'll own developer-facing content across the SonarQube product suite: conceptual guides, integration tutorials, and release documentation. You'll work directly alongside engineers and PMs, live in the same repos and PRs they do, and be expected to catch a broken code sample the same way you'd catch a grammatical error. You'll also shape how we think about documentation as a discipline — owning tooling decisions, defining style and structure, and raising the bar for the whole team.

As a Software Technical Writer, you will own developer-facing content across the SonarQube product suite. Your work will directly shape how practitioners using Sonar products—including developers, DevOps, and platform engineers—approach code quality and security. You will be the trusted expert, translating complex capabilities into practical knowledge. By crafting compelling, hands-on educational content, such as conceptual guides, in-depth tutorials, how-to-guides, etc, to help enable millions of practitioners to write high quality, secure code. You won't just explain features; you will define the developer's journey with our products, establishing Sonar as an essential part of their Agentic SDLC workflow. You'll also shape how we think about documentation as a discipline. You will influence tooling decisions, help define style and structure, and raise the bar for the whole team.

What you will do

• Plan, write, and maintain high-quality documentation for developer audiences: getting-started guides, how-tos, conceptual explanations, and release notes

•
 Work in a docs-as-code workflow — authoring in Markdown, submitting PRs, reviewing diffs, and running docs through the same CI pipeline as code

•
 Use AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, and content auditing — and take full ownership of the quality and accuracy of the output

•
 Collaborate with engineers to document new features accurately and on time, often working from specs, early builds, and code review comments

•
 Verify, and maintain code samples (in languages relevant to our integrations) to ensure they compile, run, and stay current with product changes

•
 Audit and improve existing documentation for accuracy, completeness, structure, and voice

•
 Help evolve the team's style guide, information architecture, and content standards

•
 Mentor other writers and serve as a technical resource for docs-adjacent questions from engineering

Experience you will need:

• Proven track record of creating technical content for developer audiences (provide portfolio/examples)

•
 Fluency in a docs-as-code workflow: Markdown or similar markup, Git (branching, PRs, rebasing), and working inside a repo as a first-class collaborator

•
 Strong software development or DevOps background with proficiency in some programming languages

•
 Comfort using AI tools (Claude, Codex, Copilot, etc.) to augment your workflow, with a clear-eyed approach to validating AI-generated content

•
 Experience working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to ship documentation alongside features

•
 Strong instinct for information architecture: you know the difference between a tutorial, a how-to, a reference, and a concept and when to use them

Nice to Have

•
 Solid understanding of DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines

•
 Experience writing documentation for the agentic SDLC

•
 Experience with code quality, security, and testing concepts including SAST, DAST, code coverage, and vulnerability management

•
 Demonstrated ability to read, write, and debug code — whether through writing verified code samples in technical articles, a background as a developer or software engineer, or equivalent hands-on experience

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella verifica e nella governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile.

Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA.

Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:

• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:

• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.

• Obsessed con qualità.

• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.

• Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te.

Descrizione della posizione

Stiamo cercando un Senior o uno Staff Technical Writer per unirsi al team di documentazione Sonar. Vogliamo qualcuno che pensa come uno sviluppatore, scrive come un comunicatore, e costruisce la documentazione nello stesso modo in cui gli ingegneri costruiscono software.

Potrai possedere contenuti orientati agli sviluppatori nella suite di prodotti SonarQube: guide concettuali, tutorial di integrazione e documentazione di rilascio. Potrai lavorare direttamente accanto a ingegneri e PM, vivere nello stesso repos e PR che fanno, e ci si aspetta di prendere un campione di codice rotto allo stesso modo in cui si cattura un errore grammaticale. Potrai anche modellare come pensiamo alla documentazione come una disciplina — possedere le decisioni di utensili, definire lo stile e la struttura, e sollevare il bar per l'intera squadra.

Come Scrittore Tecnico Software, possederai contenuti orientati agli sviluppatori nella suite di prodotti SonarQube. Il vostro lavoro formerà direttamente come i professionisti che utilizzano i prodotti Sonar, compresi sviluppatori, DevOps e ingegneri della piattaforma, approvino la qualità del codice e la sicurezza. Sarete l'esperto di fiducia, traducendo capacità complesse in conoscenza pratica. Creando contenuti educativi convincenti, pratici, come guide concettuali, esercitazioni approfondite, come-guida, ecc, per consentire a milioni di professionisti di scrivere codice di alta qualità, sicuro. Non solo spiegherai le funzionalità; definirai il viaggio dello sviluppatore con i nostri prodotti, stabilendo Sonar come parte essenziale del flusso di lavoro Agentic SDLC. Potrai anche modellare come pensiamo alla documentazione come disciplina. Potrai influenzare le decisioni di utensili, contribuire a definire lo stile e la struttura, e aumentare la barra per l'intero team.

Cosa farai

• Pianificare, scrivere, e mantenere la documentazione di alta qualità per il pubblico sviluppatore: le guide all'avvio, come-tos, spiegazioni concettuali e note di rilascio

•
Lavorare in un flusso di lavoro Docs-as-code — autorizzare in Markdown, presentare PR, rivedere diffs, ed eseguire documenti attraverso lo stesso canale CI come codice

•
Utilizzare gli strumenti AI per accelerare la ricerca, la stesura e l'auditing dei contenuti - e prendere la piena proprietà della qualità e precisione della produzione

•
Collaborare con gli ingegneri per documentare nuove funzionalità con precisione e puntualità, spesso lavorando da specifiche, prime build e commenti di recensione del codice

•
Verificare e mantenere campioni di codice (nelle lingue pertinenti alle nostre integrazioni) per garantire che compilano, eseguino e rimangano aggiornati con le modifiche dei prodotti

•
Verificare e migliorare la documentazione esistente per accuratezza, completezza, struttura e voce

•
Aiuta a evolvere la guida di stile del team, l'architettura delle informazioni e gli standard dei contenuti

•
Mentore altri scrittori e servire come risorsa tecnica per le domande docs-adjacent da ingegneria

Esperienza di cui avrete bisogno:

• Provato track record di creazione di contenuti tecnici per il pubblico sviluppatore (fornire portafoglio / campioni)

•
Fluency in a docs-as-code workflow: Markdown o simili markup, Git (branching, PR, rebasing), e lavorare all'interno di un repo come collaboratore di prima classe

•
Forte sviluppo software o sfondo DevOps con competenza in alcuni linguaggi di programmazione

•
Comfort utilizzando strumenti AI (Claude, Codex, Copilot, ecc.) per aumentare il flusso di lavoro, con un approccio chiaro per convalidare il contenuto generato dall'IA

•
Esperienza di lavoro cross-funzionale con team ingegneristici e di prodotto per spedire la documentazione accanto alle caratteristiche

•
Forte istinto per l'architettura dell'informazione: si conosce la differenza tra un tutorial, un how-to, un riferimento, un concetto e quando usarli

Bello da avere

•
Solida comprensione delle pratiche DevOps, comprese le tubazioni CI/CD

•
Prova documentazione di scrittura per l'agente SDLC

•
Esperienza con i concetti di qualità del codice, sicurezza e test tra cui SAST, DAST, copertura del codice e gestione delle vulnerabilità

•
Capacità dimostrata di leggere, scrivere e debug codice — sia attraverso la scrittura di campioni di codice verificati in articoli tecnici, uno sfondo come sviluppatore o ingegnere del software, o equivalente esperienza hands-on

Cultura in ufficio

Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere.

I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta.

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano.

Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com .

Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio.

Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wer ist Sonar?

Sonar treibt die Zukunft der agentenzentrierten Softwareentwicklung voran. Als führender Anbieter von KI-Code-Verifizierung und -Governance lösen wir ein entscheidendes Problem: sicherzustellen, dass Software, die von KI-unterstützten Entwicklern oder autonomen Agenten erstellt wird, zuverlässig, sicher und wartbar ist.

Durch die nahtlose Integration mit Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini und Devin helfen wir über 75% der Fortune 100 dabei, vertrauenswürdige, zuverlässige und konforme Software zu erstellen. Kunden, die Sonar verwenden, haben eine um 44% geringere Wahrscheinlichkeit, einen Ausfall aufgrund von AI-generiertem Code zu melden.

Wir glauben, dass die Codeverifizierung das kritische fehlende Glied im Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC) ist. Branchenriesen wie Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca und Ford Motor Company zählen darauf, dass wir eine unabhängige, erklärbare, konsistente Überprüfung und Governance ihres KI-generierten Codes über Produkte wie:

• SonarQube: Die weltweit führende Plattform für die Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Codes.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Derzeit Spitzenreiter bei der Reparatur von Agentic-Software.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Die Bereitstellung von Kontexten und Einschränkungen für Unternehmen muss wirklich effektiv sein.

Unser Team ist in globalen Hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Genf, London, Singapur, Tokio und Washington D.C. tätig. Wir bewegen uns mit einer Denkweise, die wir CODE nennen:

• Unseren Kunden und der Community verpflichtet.

• Besessen von Qualität.

• Absichtlich in unseren Entscheidungen.

• Effektiv als ein Team.

Mit über 400 Millionen US-Dollar Umsatz und profitablem, schnellem Wachstum bauen wir das Rückgrat der KI-Software-Revolution auf. Wenn Sie hungrig sind, etwas zu bewirken, schnell bauen und bereit sind, an der Spitze der KI zu arbeiten, möchten wir von Ihnen hören.

Positionsbeschreibung

Wir suchen einen Senior oder Staff Technical Writer, der dem Sonar-Dokumentationsteam beitritt. Wir wollen jemanden, der wie ein Entwickler denkt, wie ein Kommunikator schreibt und Dokumentation auf die gleiche Weise erstellt, wie Ingenieure Software erstellen.

Sie besitzen entwicklerorientierte Inhalte in der SonarQube-Produktsuite: konzeptionelle Anleitungen, Integrations-Tutorials und Release-Dokumentation. Sie arbeiten direkt neben Ingenieuren und PMs, leben in den gleichen Repos und PRs, die sie tun, und es wird erwartet, dass Sie ein defektes Code-Sample genauso fangen, wie Sie einen grammatikalischen Fehler bekommen. Sie werden auch gestalten, wie wir über Dokumentation als Disziplin denken - Werkzeugentscheidungen zu besitzen, Stil und Struktur zu definieren und die Messlatte für das gesamte Team zu erhöhen.

Als Software Technical Writer besitzen Sie entwicklerorientierte Inhalte in der SonarQube-Produktsuite. Ihre Arbeit wird direkt beeinflussen, wie Praktiker, die Sonar-Produkte verwenden - einschließlich Entwickler, DevOps und Plattformingenieure - Codequalität und -sicherheit angehen. Sie werden der vertrauenswürdige Experte sein und komplexe Fähigkeiten in praktisches Wissen übersetzen. Durch die Erstellung überzeugender, praktischer Bildungsinhalte, wie konzeptionelle Anleitungen, ausführliche Tutorials, Anleitungen usw., um Millionen von Praktikern zu helfen, qualitativ hochwertigen, sicheren Code zu schreiben. Sie werden nicht nur Funktionen erklären, sondern auch die Reise des Entwicklers mit unseren Produkten definieren und Sonar als wesentlichen Bestandteil seines Agentic SDLC-Workflows etablieren. Sie werden auch gestalten, wie wir über Dokumentation als Disziplin denken. Sie beeinflussen Werkzeugentscheidungen, helfen, Stil und Struktur zu definieren und die Messlatte für das gesamte Team zu erhöhen.

Was du tun wirst

• Planen, schreiben und pflegen Sie qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentation für das Entwicklerpublikum: Einstiegsleitfäden, Anleitungen, konzeptionelle Erklärungen und Release Notes

•
Arbeite in einem Docs-as-Code-Workflow - Authoring in Markdown, Einreichen von PRs, Überprüfen von Diffs und Ausführen von Docs durch dieselbe CI-Pipeline wie Code

•
Verwenden Sie KI-Tools, um Forschung, Entwurf und Content-Auditing zu beschleunigen - und übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Qualität und Genauigkeit der Ausgabe

•
Arbeiten Sie mit Ingenieuren zusammen, um neue Funktionen präzise und pünktlich zu dokumentieren, wobei Sie oft von Spezifikationen, frühen Builds und Kommentaren zur Codeüberprüfung aus arbeiten.

•
Verifizieren und pflegen Sie Codebeispiele (in Sprachen, die für unsere Integrationen relevant sind), um sicherzustellen, dass sie kompiliert, ausgeführt werden und mit Produktänderungen auf dem neuesten Stand bleiben.

•
Audit und Verbesserung der vorhandenen Dokumentation auf Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit, Struktur und Stimme

•
Helfen Sie, den Styleguide, die Informationsarchitektur und die Inhaltsstandards des Teams weiterzuentwickeln

•
Mentor andere Autoren und dienen als technische Ressource für docs-angrenzende Fragen aus dem Engineering

Erfahrung, die Sie benötigen:

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erstellung technischer Inhalte für das Entwicklerpublikum (Portfolio/Beispiele bereitstellen)

•
fließend in einem Docs-as-Code-Workflow: Markdown oder ähnliches Markup, Git (Verzweigung, PRs, Rebasing) und Arbeiten in einem Repo als erstklassiger Mitarbeiter

•
Starke Softwareentwicklung oder DevOps Hintergrund mit Kenntnissen in einigen Programmiersprachen

•
Komfort mit KI-Tools (Claude, Codex, Copilot usw.), um Ihren Workflow mit einem klaren Ansatz zur Validierung von KI-generierten Inhalten zu erweitern

•
Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und Produktteams, um Dokumentation neben Funktionen zu versenden

•
Starker Instinkt für Informationsarchitektur: Sie kennen den Unterschied zwischen einem Tutorial, einem How-To, einer Referenz und einem Konzept und wann Sie sie verwenden sollten

Nizza zu haben

•
Solides Verständnis der DevOps-Praktiken einschließlich CI/CD-Pipelines

•
Erfahrung beim Schreiben von Dokumentationen für den Agentic SDLC

•
Erfahrung mit Codequalitäts-, Sicherheits- und Testkonzepten einschließlich SAST, DAST, Code Coverage und Vulnerability Management

•
Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Code zu lesen, zu schreiben und zu debuggen - sei es durch das Schreiben verifizierter Codebeispiele in technischen Artikeln, einen Hintergrund als Entwickler oder Softwareingenieur oder eine gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung

In-Office-Kultur

Das ist unsere Absicht. Wir glauben, dass die besten Teams gemeinsam im Raum gebaut werden. Drei Ankertage - montags, dienstags und donnerstags - schaffen den Kollaborationsrhythmus, der ein Hub-Office wert macht.

Die Kandidaten müssen wirklich an dem Ort ansässig sein, an dem die Rolle veröffentlicht wird - wenn Sie heute nicht dort sind, unterstützen wir gerne den Umzug für die richtige Person.

Wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion

Bei Sonar glauben wir, dass unsere Vielfalt unsere Stärke ist. Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen, das unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Kulturen schätzt und respektiert. Wir setzen uns für ein vielfältiges und integratives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich jeder geschätzt und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes zu geben. Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein und begrüßen alle qualifizierten Bewerber, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, nationaler Herkunft, Genetik, Behinderung, Alter oder Veteranenstatus.

Wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte unter hiring@sonarsource.com.

Alle Beschäftigungsangebote bei Sonar hängen von den Ergebnissen einer umfassenden Hintergrundprüfung und Referenzüberprüfung ab, die vor dem Startdatum durchgeführt wurden.

Bewerbungen, die über Agenturen oder Drittanbieter eingereicht werden, werden nicht berücksichtigt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui est Sonar ?

Sonar dirige l'avenir du développement de logiciels centrés sur les agents. En tant que chef de file en matière de vérification et de gouvernance des codes d'IA, nous résolvons un problème critique : veiller à ce que les logiciels générés par les développeurs assistés par l'IA ou les agents autonomes soient fiables, sécurisés et durables.

En s'intégrant parfaitement avec Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75% des logiciels de construction Fortune 100 fiables, conformes. Les clients qui utilisent Sonar sont 44 % moins susceptibles de signaler une panne en raison du code généré par l'IA.

Nous croyons que la vérification du code est le lien manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement Agent-Centric (AC/DC). Les géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company comptent sur nous pour fournir un examen indépendant, explicable, cohérent et la gouvernance de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits comme:

• SonarQube: Le monde est la principale plate-forme de révision et de vérification de code AI.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: En ce moment, les classements pour la réparation de logiciels mandataires.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Contexte Augmentation : fournir le contexte de qualité entreprise et les agents de contraintes doivent être vraiment efficaces.

Notre équipe opère à travers des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous bougeons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE:

• Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.

• Obsédé par la qualité.

• Délibérer dans nos décisions.

• Efficace comme une seule équipe.

Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. Si vous avez faim d'avoir un impact, voulez construire à un rythme rapide, et prêt à travailler à l'avant-garde de l'IA, nous voulons entendre de vous.

Description de la position

Nous cherchons un rédacteur technique senior ou du personnel pour rejoindre l'équipe de documentation Sonar. Nous voulons quelqu'un qui pense comme un développeur, écrit comme un communicateur, et construit la documentation de la même façon que les ingénieurs construisent des logiciels.

Vous posséderez du contenu orienté vers le développeur dans la suite de produits SonarQube : guides conceptuels, tutoriels d'intégration et documentation de sortie. Vous travaillerez directement aux côtés des ingénieurs et des PM, vivrez dans les mêmes repos et PR qu'ils font, et être censé attraper un échantillon de code cassé de la même façon que vous attraperiez une erreur grammaticale. Vous façonnerez également la façon dont nous considérons la documentation comme une discipline – posséder des décisions d'outillage, définir le style et la structure, et élever la barre pour toute l'équipe.

En tant que rédacteur technique de logiciels, vous posséderez du contenu orienté développeur dans la suite de produits SonarQube. Votre travail façonnera directement la façon dont les praticiens utilisant les produits Sonar – y compris les développeurs, DevOps et les ingénieurs de plateforme – adoptent la qualité et la sécurité du code. Vous serez l'expert de confiance, transformant des capacités complexes en connaissances pratiques. En élaborant des contenus éducatifs convaincants et pratiques, tels que des guides conceptuels, des tutoriels approfondis, des guides pratiques, etc., afin de permettre à des millions de praticiens d'écrire des codes sécurisés de haute qualité. Vous n'expliquerez pas seulement les fonctionnalités ; vous définirez le parcours du développeur avec nos produits, établissant Sonar comme une partie essentielle de leur flux de travail SDLC Agentique. Vous façonnerez aussi la façon dont nous considérons la documentation comme une discipline. Vous allez influencer les décisions d'outillage, aider à définir le style et la structure, et augmenter la barre pour toute l'équipe.

Ce que vous ferez

• Planifiez, écrivez et maintenez une documentation de haute qualité pour le public des développeurs : guides de démarrage, comment faire, explications conceptuelles et notes de diffusion

•
Travaillez dans un workflow docs-as-code — création dans Markdown, soumission des PR, examen des diffs et exécution des docs par le même pipeline CI que le code

•
Utiliser les outils d'IA pour accélérer la recherche, la rédaction et l'audit de contenu, et s'approprier pleinement la qualité et l'exactitude des résultats

•
Collaborer avec les ingénieurs pour documenter les nouvelles caractéristiques avec précision et à temps, souvent en travaillant à partir de spécifications, de constructions précoces et de commentaires de révision de code

•
Vérifier, et maintenir des échantillons de code (dans des langues pertinentes à nos intégrations) pour s'assurer qu'ils compilent, fonctionnent et restent à jour avec les changements de produit

•
Vérification et amélioration de la documentation existante pour l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité, la structure et la voix

•
Aider à développer le guide de style de l'équipe, l'architecture de l'information et les normes de contenu

•
Mentor autres écrivains et servir de ressource technique pour les questions docs-adjacentes de l'ingénierie

Expérience dont vous aurez besoin :

• Expérience éprouvée de la création de contenu technique pour le public développeur (fournir des portfolios/exemples)

•
Fluctuation dans un workflow docs-as-code: Markdown ou un balisage similaire, Git (branchage, PR, rebasing) et travailler à l'intérieur d'une repo en tant que collaborateur de première classe

•
Développement de logiciels ou DevOps solide avec maîtrise de certains langages de programmation

•
Confort d'utilisation des outils AI (Claude, Codex, Copilot, etc.) pour augmenter votre flux de travail, avec une approche claire pour valider le contenu généré par l'IA

•
Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de produits pour expédier la documentation aux côtés des caractéristiques

•
Un fort instinct pour l'architecture de l'information : vous connaissez la différence entre un tutoriel, un mode d'emploi, une référence et un concept et quand les utiliser

Sympa d'avoir

•
Une bonne compréhension des pratiques DevOps, y compris les pipelines CI/CD

•
Expérience de la documentation de rédaction pour le SDLC agent

•
Expérience des concepts de qualité, de sécurité et de test du code, y compris SAST, DAST, couverture du code et gestion de la vulnérabilité

•
Capacité démontrée de lire, d'écrire et de déboguer le code — que ce soit par l'écriture d'échantillons de code vérifiés dans des articles techniques, un arrière-plan en tant que développeur ou ingénieur logiciel, ou une expérience pratique équivalente

Culture interne

On est intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant.

Les candidats doivent être vraiment basés dans l'endroit où le rôle est affiché — si ce n'est pas là où vous êtes aujourd'hui, nous sommes heureux d'appuyer la réinstallation pour la bonne personne.

Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran.

Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse embauche@sonarsource.com .

Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début.

Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) - Remediation Agent
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we believe that simply reporting code issues is not sufficient. To truly level up the quality of the world's software, we must empower millions of developers to fix them automatically. With over 400,000 enterprises relying on our products, we hold a unique lever to shape how software is built.

Recent breakthroughs in AI have made autonomous remediation a reality, but one major hurdle remains: Trust . Generative AI makes mistakes, and enterprises cannot automate what they do not trust. This is where you come in. As a Senior/Staff Engineer, you will architect the backend for Verified Autonomous Remediation , a sophisticated Agentic workflow that doesn’t just generate code, but rigorously tests and validates it using Sonar’s analysis engine. You will tackle the hard engineering problems required to close the "Trust Gap."

What you will do

• Architect the "Unified Remediation Engine". You will design the high-throughput decision logic that powers our remediation efforts. You will build the backend services that intelligently route requests between deterministic instant QuickFixes, LLM-based reasoning fixes, and complex Agentic flows.

• Build Robust Agent Architecture. You will contribute to the Sonar Remediation Agent code, transitioning research concepts to a resilient, high-scale production service. You will implement self-healing workflows where the Agent iteratively fixes the code it produces until the build is green.

• Solve the "Sandboxing" Problem. You will architect the secure execution environments required to run untrusted, AI-generated code. You will design the isolation layers that allow Agents to iterate on code improvements without compromising our infrastructure.

• Engineer for Reliability & Safety. You will implement critical safety mechanisms, like Circuit Breakers to automatically reroute requests to the proper engine when acceptance rates drop. Crucially, you will own the cost/performance trade-off, ensuring our AWS architecture scales to millions of events without letting token costs spiral.

• Act as a Technical "Force Multiplier". Beyond building systems, you’ll mentor the squad through design reviews and collaborate with the Research team to ensure our agent is not just state-of-the-art, but production-safe.

Experience and qualifications

• Strong Backend & Cloud Expertise. You have 8+ years of experience building scalable resilient systems. You are strong in AWS architecture and know how to design for high availability and low latency with cost in mind.

• Polyglot Ecosystem (Java & Python). You are comfortable operating in a hybrid environment: Java for deep integration with the Core Sonar analysis engine and Python for the AI/Agent reasoning layer. You should be strong in one and capable in the other. We make use of various LLM tools, and are looking for people not afraid of different languages.

• Systems Thinking. You understand that "AI" in production is mostly "Systems Engineering." You know how to handle asynchronous event-driven architectures, manage queues, and design sandboxed execution environments to run untrusted code safely.

• AI & LLM Integration. You have practical experience building applications that orchestrate LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or hosted open models). You understand the backend complexity of RAG, context window management, and prompt engineering at scale.

• Data-Driven Mindset. You care about the "Why." You want to build telemetry pipelines that distinguish between "Bad UX" and "Bad Code," focusing on the metrics that matter.

Additional comments
 This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella revisione e nella verifica del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile.

Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA.

Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company. contare su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA tramite prodotti come:

•
SonarQube: la piattaforma di verifica e revisione del codice AI leader nel mondo.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:

•
Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.

•
Obsessed con qualità.

•
Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.

•
Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te.

Descrizione della posizione

A Sonar, crediamo che semplicemente segnalare problemi di codice non sia sufficiente. Per livellare veramente la qualità del software del mondo, dobbiamo dare potere a milioni di sviluppatori di risolverli automaticamente. Con oltre 400.000 aziende che si affidano ai nostri prodotti, abbiamo una leva unica per modellare come il software è costruito.

Recenti scoperte in AI hanno reso la rimediazione autonoma una realtà, ma rimane un ostacolo importante: Trust . L'intelligenza artificiale generativa fa errori e le imprese non possono automatizzare ciò che non si fidano. E' qui che entri. In qualità di Ingegnere Senior/Staff, si articolerà il backend per la Rimediazione Autonoma verificata , un sofisticato flusso di lavoro Agentic che non solo genera codice, ma rigorosamente testa e lo convalida utilizzando il motore di analisi di Sonar. Si affronterà i problemi di ingegneria difficili necessari per chiudere il "Trust Gap".

Cosa farai

• Architetto il "Unified Remediation Engine". Progetterai la logica decisionale ad alto rendimento che alimenta i nostri sforzi di bonifica. Costruirete i servizi di backend che in modo intelligente indirizzano le richieste tra deterministici QuickFixes istantanei, soluzioni di ragionamento basate su LLM e flussi Agentici complessi.

• Costruisci Robusta Agent Architecture. Contribuirai al codice dell'agente Sonar Remediation, trasformando i concetti di ricerca in un servizio di produzione resiliente e su larga scala. Realizzerai flussi di lavoro auto-guarigione in cui l'agente risolve in modo iterativo il codice che produce fino a quando la costruzione è verde.

• Risolvi il problema "Sandboxing". Architerai gli ambienti di esecuzione sicuri necessari per eseguire codice non attendibile e generato dall'IA. Potrai progettare gli strati di isolamento che permettono agli agenti di iterare sui miglioramenti del codice senza compromettere la nostra infrastruttura.

• Ingegnere per affidabilità e sicurezza. Attuerai meccanismi di sicurezza critici, come Circuit Breakers per reindirizzare automaticamente le richieste al motore corretto quando i tassi di accettazione scendono. Crucialmente, si possiede il costo / performance trade-off, assicurando la nostra architettura AWS scale a milioni di eventi senza lasciare token costi spirale.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we believe that simply reporting code issues is not sufficient. To truly level up the quality of the world's software, we must empower millions of developers to fix them automatically. With over 400,000 enterprises relying on our products, we hold a unique lever to shape how software is built.

Recent breakthroughs in AI have made autonomous remediation a reality, but one major hurdle remains: Trust . Generative AI makes mistakes, and enterprises cannot automate what they do not trust. This is where you come in. As a Senior/Staff Engineer, you will architect the backend for Verified Autonomous Remediation , a sophisticated Agentic workflow that doesn’t just generate code, but rigorously tests and validates it using Sonar’s analysis engine. You will tackle the hard engineering problems required to close the "Trust Gap."

What you will do

• Architect the "Unified Remediation Engine". You will design the high-throughput decision logic that powers our remediation efforts. You will build the backend services that intelligently route requests between deterministic instant QuickFixes, LLM-based reasoning fixes, and complex Agentic flows.

• Build Robust Agent Architecture. You will contribute to the Sonar Remediation Agent code, transitioning research concepts to a resilient, high-scale production service. You will implement self-healing workflows where the Agent iteratively fixes the code it produces until the build is green.

• Solve the "Sandboxing" Problem. You will architect the secure execution environments required to run untrusted, AI-generated code. You will design the isolation layers that allow Agents to iterate on code improvements without compromising our infrastructure.

• Engineer for Reliability & Safety. You will implement critical safety mechanisms, like Circuit Breakers to automatically reroute requests to the proper engine when acceptance rates drop. Crucially, you will own the cost/performance trade-off, ensuring our AWS architecture scales to millions of events without letting token costs spiral.

• Act as a Technical "Force Multiplier". Beyond building systems, you’ll mentor the squad through design reviews and collaborate with the Research team to ensure our agent is not just state-of-the-art, but production-safe.

Experience and qualifications

• Strong Backend & Cloud Expertise. You have 8+ years of experience building scalable resilient systems. You are strong in AWS architecture and know how to design for high availability and low latency with cost in mind.

• Polyglot Ecosystem (Java & Python). You are comfortable operating in a hybrid environment: Java for deep integration with the Core Sonar analysis engine and Python for the AI/Agent reasoning layer. You should be strong in one and capable in the other. We make use of various LLM tools, and are looking for people not afraid of different languages.

• Systems Thinking. You understand that "AI" in production is mostly "Systems Engineering." You know how to handle asynchronous event-driven architectures, manage queues, and design sandboxed execution environments to run untrusted code safely.

• AI & LLM Integration. You have practical experience building applications that orchestrate LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or hosted open models). You understand the backend complexity of RAG, context window management, and prompt engineering at scale.

• Data-Driven Mindset. You care about the "Why." You want to build telemetry pipelines that distinguish between "Bad UX" and "Bad Code," focusing on the metrics that matter.

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.

Obsédé par la qualité.

Délibérer dans nos décisions.

Efficace comme une seule équipe.

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que le simple fait de signaler des problèmes de code n'est pas suffisant. L'IA générative fait des erreurs, et les entreprises ne peuvent pas automatiser ce qu'elles ne font pas confiance. C'est ici que vous entrez. En tant qu'ingénieur principal/fonctionnaire, vous serez l'architecte du moteur de réparation autonome, un flux de travail Agentique sophistiqué qui ne génère pas seulement du code, mais teste et valide rigoureusement à l'aide du moteur d'analyse Sonar. Vous allez construire les services de backend qui relient intelligemment les requêtes entre QuickFixes instantanées déterministes, les corrections de raisonnement basées sur LLM et les flux Agentic complexes.

• Construire une architecture d'agent robuste. Vous contribuerez au code d'agent d'assainissement Sonar, en transformant les concepts de recherche en un service de production résistant et à grande échelle. Vous appliquerez des workflows d'auto-guérison où l'Agent corrige itérativement le code qu'il produit jusqu'à ce que la construction soit verte.

Principalement, vous aurez le compromis coût/performance, assurant notre architecture AWS échelle à des millions d'événements sans laisser spirale des coûts de jeton.

• Agir en tant que « multiplicateur de force » technique. Au-delà des systèmes de construction, vous mentorez l'équipe à travers des examens de conception et collaborez avec l'équipe de recherche pour s'assurer que notre agent n'est pas seulement à la fine pointe de la technologie, mais en sécurité de production.

• Forte expertise backend & Cloud. Vous avez 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans la construction de systèmes résilients évolutives. Vous êtes fort dans l'architecture AWS et savez concevoir pour une grande disponibilité et faible latence avec des coûts en tête.

Vous savez comment gérer les architectures asynchrones animées par des événements, gérer les files d'attente et concevoir des environnements d'exécution sandboxed pour exécuter un code non fiable en toute sécurité.

• Intégration AI & LLM. Vous avez une expérience pratique de construction d'applications qui orchestrent les LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, ou les modèles ouverts hébergés). Vous comprenez la complexité du moteur de RAG, la gestion des fenêtres contextuelles et l'ingénierie rapide à l'échelle.

• Mindset d'entraînement de données. Tu tiens au "Pourquoi". Vous voulez construire des pipelines de télémétrie qui distinguent entre "Bad UX" et "Bad Code", en se concentrant sur les mesures qui comptent.

Nous valorisons la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion

Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer au mieux. descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Platform Product Manager to drive the foundational capabilities that make our products enterprise-ready, trusted by the world’s largest organizations and truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for our core platform infrastructure. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in enterprise SaaS capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of core infrastructure and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform, ensuring that our customers experience enterprise-grade reliability, compliance, and top-tier performance, and have a seamless experience in the product. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, DevOps, and security teams, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our core platform, from very high-level user settings down to the technical aspects of our infrastructure.

You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help teams adopt our software at scale to write better and more secure code.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of enterprise-grade platforms (such as data sovereignty, encryption, or global performance scaling) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide an awesome user experience to millions of developers.

What you will do

• Contribute to the different areas of the Platform vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

•
Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on customer trust and platform readiness.

•
Interact directly with our users and customers on our product forum to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

•
Develop a deep understanding of customer-facing platform needs (e.g., data residency, advanced access controls, and application performance) and how we can enable organizations to scale seamlessly..

•
Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product foundational features.

•
Align with the engineering and UX teams on the foundational system and usability problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

•
Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

•
Attend conferences and give talks about platform scale if you like.

•
Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

• Passionate about enterprise software operability and the practices that lead to secure and highly available applications.

•
Deep understanding of core platform pillars (e.g., data isolation, customer-managed encryption, design systems, API best-practices, or global performance optimization).

•
Technical comprehension of self-hosted deployment, cloud-native environments, multi-region deployments, and data residency frameworks.

•
Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding and how they impact platform scale.

•
Experience in software product management, preferably managing platform products in an agile context.

•
Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems.

•
Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

•
Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

•
Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

•
Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The Impact You Will Have:

The Partner Manager wins, maintains, and expands relationships with assigned channel partners. Assigned to channel partners based on geography, channel, or market, the Partner Manager is responsible for achieving qualified pipeline development, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives. The Partner Manager represents the entire range of Sonar’s products and services to assigned partners though may focus on a specific solution or product set if focused in a partner vertical market. The Partner Manager reports to the Vice President of EMEA & APJ Channels. The success of a Sonar Partner is the success of a Partner Manager at Sonar! We believe the following will support a robust Partner Ecosystem and contribute to the success of Sonar’s strategic partners: We are looking for passionate and energetic team members to join us in building a strong and healthy partner ecosystem.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Discover, evaluate, and develop potential partners with business models and technology stacks that complement Sonar’s offerings

• Potential partners include Global and Regional Consulting Partners, System Integrators, Software Resellers, Technology Alliance and Distributors and where applicable Hyperscalers.

• Develop partner territory plan for a regional and execute the business plan to deliver outcomes measures in new bookings $, Renewal $ and % and new logos

• Establishes productive, professional, and strong relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts and territoriesInitiates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, sales, marketing, and management resources that would contribute to the success of the partner ecosystem

• Engaged in meaningful business and account QBR’s to support partners in meeting assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts

• Build momentum and executable next steps in the joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs on an ongoing basis

• Proactive management with Sonar’s channel policies, stringent expectations management of partners to minimize channel conflict

• Ensures partners receive and complete the required enablement program Ensures partner and Sonar’s continuous business and technology aligns and complies.

The Experience You Will Need:

• 7+ years of proven experience in channel and partner management in a technology software B2B, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model, Dev Tools experience would be a plus

• Proven track record in building, maintaining, and expanding high-performance partners in the EMEA region

• Self-starter, can-do attitude and willingness to roll up sleeves and never afraid to do the impossible

• Strong communication and listening skills, able to influence at all levels

• Strong ability to work effectively as part of a team. Be a bar raiser in the company values and culture

• Curious, willing to unlearn to learn. Confident and a great communicator

• MUST HAVE - Relationships and experience working with key VAR's including Softcat, Bytes, Computercentre, and Insight

• NICE TO HAVE - Working with Crayon SoftwareOne, bespoke DevOps VAR's

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate engineers who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance. This includes maintaining our internal applications and developing new applications that will help us support the growth of the business.

You are confident in owning and evolving our NetSuite instance to support a fast-growing, multi-site, and multi-national organization. With several years of hands-on NetSuite experience, you understand how to scale and adapt the platform to meet complex business needs. You thrive in dynamic environments and are motivated by the challenges that come with rapid growth.

What you will do

• Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and maintenance of our NetSuite instance and related systems, ensuring stability, security, and scalability.

• Manage user roles, permissions, profiles, and access, aligning with ITIL-based processes and compliance standards.

• Lead and document change management processes, including communication, implementation, and impact assessments.

• Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate evolving business needs into scalable system configurations and solutions.

• Support and maintain internal tools, and implement enhancements to NetSuite modules in alignment with business process requirements.

• Design, build, and maintain custom NetSuite solutions using SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, and SuiteTalk.

• Develop, implement, and troubleshoot API integrations between NetSuite and third-party systems.

• Create and optimize workflows, automation scripts, and process efficiencies across departments.

• Lead and execute data migrations, transformations, and data quality assurance tasks.

• Build customized dashboards and reports for stakeholders at all organizational levels.

• Conduct testing and QA of system enhancements, ensuring alignment with business and technical expectations.

• Stay current with ERP and NetSuite best practices, identifying opportunities for system enhancements and upgrades.

• Provide training, guidance, and documentation for end users to ensure effective adoption and support.

• Partner with IT Operations to ensure prompt resolution of incidents and system issues.

• Evaluate and communicate ITGC (IT General Controls) gaps in coordination with internal controls and third-party assessments.

Experience and qualifications

• Proven experience (5+ years) administrating NetSuite and Operational & Functional support for Finance & Accounting related applications, with a focus on Oracle Netsuite

• Strong understanding of Netsuite modules and their integration with business processes

• A plus: Experience with third-party integrations such as Salesforce CPQ, Pigment, Aptitude, Stripe, and procurement tools

• Experience with SuiteScript (1.0 & 2.0), JavaScript and familiarity with RESTlet/SOAP APIs for custom development and integrations

• Must have a NetSuite Administrator Certificate

• Experience designing, implementing, and executing IT general computer controls to comply with Sarbanes-Oxley requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

• Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills

• Highly autonomous and pragmatic

• Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude

• Prefer to work in a team, share information, and ideas and understand the power of collective thinking to get the best solutions

• Comfortable in dealing with change and complexity

• Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive and give feedback to improve the team and yourself

• Leadership: Taking the initiative and demonstrating your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end

• Valuing “done” over “perfect”

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella verifica e nella governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile.

Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme.
